price_up.text: The model provider raised prices “due to increased value”. Tokens cost 40% more — for three sprints

free_rival.text: A giant released the same product for free. Clients haggle: bills are 20% smaller — for three sprints

new_model.text: A new version of the model is out. Half of your prompts no longer work: +8 debt

rival_demo.text: A competitor showed “%s” at a conference. Those who waited for it from you are tired of waiting: patience −1

outage.text: The model provider is down. Your product is down together with everyone else’s — until the release

viral.text: Your post “we are not a wrapper” went viral. Two companies came to take a look: +2 leads

hype.text: AI is in fashion again this week. Promotion works one and a half times better — for three sprints

refund.text: A tax refund you didn’t know about has arrived: +$400. Accounting is a product too

launch_day.text: You got featured on a launch platform. Three companies came to look, one — to criticize the fonts: +3 leads

price_war.text: Model providers started a price war. You got caught in it, in a good way: tokens cost 30% less — for three sprints

data_law.text: A new data law has passed. You needed a lawyer yesterday: +6 debt

bubble_post.text: A famous blogger called AI wrappers a bubble. Promotion works 40% worse — for three sprints

procurement_week.text: Procurement opened quarterly budgets. Promotion +25% for two sprints: someone finally read the email.

budget_freeze.text: Clients announced a savings drive. Bills −10% for two sprints; the coffee subscription survived.

self_service_guide.text: Small businesses shared a guide without a meeting. +3 leads: apparently that works too.

scaleup_digest.text: A growing-business newsletter featured you. +4 leads and an offer to buy a higher position.

security_questionnaire.text: A hundred-page security questionnaire arrived. Four promises were found in the answers: +4 debt.

model_cache.text: The provider learned to cache identical answers. Tokens −15% for two sprints; the press release is new.

context_inflation.text: Every request now starts with the company history. Tokens +20% for two sprints.

honest_demo.text: Someone showed the product without editing the demo. People were surprised: promotion +30% for two sprints.

ai_fatigue.text: The phrase “we added AI” became a spam filter. Promotion −20% for two sprints.

benchmark_patch.text: The impressive benchmark met real documents. +5 debt: a spreadsheet beat the presentation.

stable_sdk.text: The SDK fixed a bug you had worked around with three prompts. Debt −4.

local_meetup.text: Two people at the founder meetup turned out to be customers rather than coaches. +2 leads.

service_reputation.text: Clients remembered that answering support is a rare feature. Bills +10% for two sprints.

comparison_sheet.text: A competitor published a comparison with every checkmark in its own column. Promotion −15% for two sprints.

migration_season.text: A neighbouring service is closing its free plan. +5 leads carrying suitcases of spreadsheets.

invoice_cleanup.text: Found a hosting invoice paid twice. $240 refunded; accounting earned its first revenue.

support_summit.text: “We answer people” became the conference breakthrough. Promotion +15% for three sprints.

longer_trial.text: Companies extended payment approval. Bills −15% for one sprint: everyone agrees, no signature.

prompt_compaction.text: Removed “please” from the prompt four hundred times. Tokens −10% for three sprints.

rival_deadline.text: A competitor promises “%s” by Friday. Waiting clients lost one sprint of patience.
